name: Lighthouse Marina
brand_truth: Since 1980, the fuel dock, boatyard and ship’s store at the foot of the Elbow Reef Lighthouse, with the only marine fuel on Elbow Cay.
buyer: Boaters in Hope Town (renters and owners of centre consoles, cruisers to 60 ft), second-home owners and captains needing fuel, a slip, a haul-out or a mechanic.

direction.lane: P13 Hull and brass (light hull-paper ground, navy fields, brass accent)
direction.why: The marina’s one true asset is a place seen sideways: from the lighthouse gallery and along the dock. A precise grotesk suits a working fuel dock and boatyard; the same-harbour neighbour Hope Town Inn uses a split serif layout.

concept_type: brochure: harbour services + boatyard rates + slip/service request
tier_reason: No WebGL: the arrival is a real panorama shot from the lighthouse gallery, scrubbed sideways by scroll; 3D would add nothing a real photo from the tower does not already prove.
current_site_findings: (c) 2023 footer, Gmail contact, default Wix favicon and title
No dockage rates; the Dockage button leads to boatyard rates
DIY yard rate $50/day on rates page, $40/day on facilities page
Liquor store reopening soon on homepage but listed in menu
Small blurred homepage thumbnails; key facts never reach the Google snippet
pitch_line: Your marina finally opens on the view only you have: the harbour from the top of your lighthouse, then straight down to the only fuel dock on Elbow Cay, with slip check, yard estimator and VHF 16 one tap away.
assumptions: Dockage (slip) rates are not published: the site routes to a request instead
DIY rate shown as $50/day from the newer rates page; facilities page says $40
Liquor store left out (reopening status unclear)
Rental cottages shown as currently on long-term rental (their own page)
Lighthouse facts (built 1862, red and white, first-order Fresnel lens) from Wikimedia Commons categories
Fuel dock hours are not published, so none are shown
notes: BLIND sandbox (Wix and Wikimedia blocked): photos were seen in the Lovable gallery ip-assets-lighthouse-marina and QA used crops of it routed into Playwright. Wikimedia thumbs must use standard widths (1920px, 3840px); 1200px returns 400. Plan gate (one critic, mode 1) asked: headline off the photo, phone once, pan to end on the fuel dock, bigger phone band with caption strip, fold mechanic into boatyard; all applied. Self-critique after build: hero and slip check strong; yard section uses a sticky left column; tabular figures switched off in rate tables because Schibsted tabular period reads as a gap. Store hours Mon-Sat 8-4 sourced from ships-store page. React hydration replaced by client render over prerendered HTML (418 mismatch).
